Penalty Eagerness

Is a referee quicker or slower to give a penalty than to give a foul elsewhere on the pitch? Box = penalties vs expected from shots inside the box. Elsewhere = other fouls vs expected from the two teams' usual foul counts. Eagerness = Box ÷ Elsewhere. Bars are 90% intervals; small samples are pulled towards average.
